fusions.name: Four-Count Drill
fusions.desc: A drilled thrust of the tines that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Master's Correction
fusions.desc: A flawless thrust that deals 28 damage and is always a critical hit, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Call the Drill Line
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Pass
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
